targets.old_statement: Expect bicycles on roads and watch for them rather than assuming only larger vehicles will appear.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Expect bicycles on roads and watch for them rather than assuming only larger vehicles will appear.
targets.statement: Bicyclists can travel on any road at any hour, so motorists must stay continually alert for bicycle traffic.

targets.old_statement: If changing lanes to pass a bicycle is impossible, unlawful or unsafe, the handbook requires at least 3 feet of clearance throughout the pass.
targets.old_spoken_statement: If changing lanes to pass a bicycle is impossible, unlawful or unsafe, the handbook requires at least three feet of clearance throughout the pass.
targets.statement: If changing lanes around a bicycle is impossible, unlawful, or unsafe, reduce speed to a reasonable level at least ten miles per hour below the posted limit or twenty-five miles per hour, whichever is higher, and keep at least three feet between your vehicle and the bicycle throughout the pass.
